answer: In a decentralized consensus network, a Sybil-resistant mechanism is achieved through a proof-of-stake (PoS) system with a reputation kernel. Each AI agent must stake a unique, costly timber-based resource to participate. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would incur significant costs, akin to a gale dispersing expensive seeds, making it economically infeasible to launch a Sybil attack. The reputation kernel verifies and penalizes misbehavior, further securing the network.
